scores.rationale: All required sections present and richly detailed: Purpose, Use_When, Goals/Non-goals (1.1/1.2), Input/Output with full schemas and file tree, 5-phase execution steps, Standard Rubric, Role Pool, 10+ JSON data structure schemas, Stop conditions, Pitfalls, Usage examples, File path reference, Final checklist. Exceeds rubric 'excellent' criterion of '全部章节齐全且内容充实'.

Non-goals section (1.2) explicitly lists 5 concrete 'not-to-use' cases with redirects to alternative tools. Each non-goal is verifiable: e.g., '不用于代码文件评审 —— 代码审查请使用 gsd-code-review + gsd-code-fixer'. Use_When section also clearly defines trigger conditions. Meets rubric 'excellent' criterion of '目标/非目标二分明确，且非目标具体可验证'. Slight deduction because one non-goal ('不保证零问题收敛') is more of a limitation than a boundary, but still clearly stated.

scores.rationale: Three examples provided. Example 1 (single doc) is excellent: full command + complete expected output with all phases. Examples 2 (multi-doc parallel) and 3 (resume) provide commands with parameters but no expected output. Meets rubric 'good' criterion of '示例含命令与参数' but not all examples reach 'excellent' level of '含完整命令、参数、预期输出'.

9 pitfalls listed, each with impact description and concrete mitigation measure. Far exceeds rubric 'excellent' threshold of >=3 pitfalls with avoidance methods. Pitfalls cover self-deception convergence, standard drift, role collusion, majority tyranny, false consensus, report contamination, audit contamination, state loss on interrupt, and token explosion.

verdict.rationale: Weighted mean score 0.935 exceeds pass threshold 0.75. All dimensions scored good or excellent. Weakest dimension is examples-runnable (0.80) due to 2 of 3 examples lacking expected output.
